features.name: has_bold_single_word_comment
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment contain bold single-word emphasis written as **word**?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as a JSON list of strings; malformed/missing -> null; empty list -> 0. Return 1 if any comment matches regex r'(?<!\*)\*\*[^\s*]+\*\*(?!\*)' (double asterisks around exactly one whitespace-free token), else 0. Raw text match; no semantic filtering.

h0: has_bold_single_word_comment has no association with delta.
h1: Rows with has_bold_single_word_comment=1 have higher delta rate than rows with 0.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change). Row-level any-comment presence is used; comment-level persuasion is unavailable since no per-comment outcomes exist, so the association cannot be attributed to the bold comments themselves. Markdown may have been altered in the supplied text; raw text may include outcome announcements. Association only, not causal.
